description: Completed Kaggle CPU v2 run; validation selected torch_mlp_huber for Cl, Cd and Cm. No new fit was used to create this pin.

projection.test_metrics.csv: Exact byte copy of all original test records, including other metrics, timing, selected model and prediction counts.
projection.run.json: Original values, compact formatting; only run_metadata.feature_columns and results.*.training_metadata.history omitted. All dataset fingerprints, full split membership lists, targets/transforms, row counts, statuses, model configurations, validation metrics and remaining hardware/stopping provenance retained. history_truncated describes the source history, not this projection.

guard_policy.limitations: Report validation cannot prove a producer did not inspect test data. Original reports attest validation selection and stopping but contain no explicit test_used_for_tuning declaration. This pin is a single run, not a seed-variance confidence interval. PR unit tests exercise the guard; a completed source-pinned Kaggle candidate is required for an actual regression check.
